D.treatment: domain-specific modeling languages in computer-based learning environments

cells.quote: Adopting learning-by-modeling approaches in K-12 STEM (STEM) classrooms has proven to be an effective vehicle for integrating the teaching and learning of STEM and computational thinking (CT), helping students become active constructors as opposed to passive consumers of scientific knowledge and practices (Lehrer and Schauble 2015; Clark et al. 2009; Sun and Looi 2013; Wieman et al. 2008).
cells.note: The supplied study text makes a general narrative claim about effectiveness and cites prior studies, but does not report a specific comparison, design, numerical effect, or significance result for the cited CTSiM, ViMap, or CT-STEM studies. The wiki entry's quoted sentence is not present in the supplied study text.
